key_idea: Everything is decidable exactly with integer cross products (parallel), dot products (right angle) and squared side lengths, tested in the given priority order.
sketch: Compute the four edge vectors in order. Parallelogram = both opposite pairs have zero cross product; rectangle = parallelogram plus one zero dot product; rhombus = four equal squared lengths; square = both; trapezium = at least one parallel pair; kite = two pairs of equal adjacent sides around either diagonal. O(1). Pitfalls: coordinates up to 1e9 give squared lengths and cross products up to 2e18, which just fit in signed 64-bit; do not use floating point; check the kite only after the trapezium since priority is fixed.
